checkpointPayload.description: Cho phép global admin xử lý hàng đợi yêu cầu và cấu hình data-group/contractor scope trên Android bằng trạng thái Firebase dùng chung. Phụ thuộc: task 02. Spec: @doc/specs/2026-08-23/firebase-project-sync-approval-approved
checkpointPayload.title: [firebase-project-sync-approval-04] Quản trị phê duyệt trên Android

newValue.text: Global admin trên Android xem được hàng đợi và thực hiện approve, reject hoặc revoke với data-group/contractor scope hợp lệ.
Người không có admin claim không thấy hoặc không thực hiện được thao tác quản trị.
Quyết định Android cập nhật nguồn trạng thái dùng chung và tạo audit record chính xác.

taskChanges.newValue:
1. Extend ProjectViewModel UI state with admin queue properties (isAdmin, adminRequests, isAdminRequestsLoading, adminRequestsError, adminStatusFilter, isApprovalDialogVisible, selectedRequestForApproval) and auto-observe admin requests for admin sessions.
2. Implement admin operations in ProjectViewModel: loadAdminRequests(status), approveAccessRequest(projectId, targetUserId, allowedDataGroups, contractorScope, allowedContractors) with validateApprovedScope validation, rejectAccessRequest(projectId, targetUserId), and revokeAccessRequest(projectId, targetUserId).
3. Add AdminApprovalSection and AdminApprovalDialog in ProjectScreen.kt gated strictly by state.isAdmin == true, providing status filtering, scope configuration chips/inputs, and approve/reject/revoke actions.
4. Add comprehensive unit tests in ProjectAdminApprovalTest.kt verifying non-admin gate, request listing/filtering, scope validation (rejecting empty data groups or scoped contractors), and approve/reject/revoke state updates.
5. Run :project:testDebugUnitTest, :app:compileDebugKotlin, and knowns validate to verify D1-D7 compliance and zero Firebase SDK leaks in UI modules.

taskChanges.newValue:
1. Extend FirebaseAccessViewModel with admin request queue state, bounded queue refresh, and guarded approve/reject/revoke actions using the shared repository transition contract.
2. Add admin queue UI to the Android catalog surface; expose valid data-group approval defaults, reject/revoke controls, and hide all admin actions for non-admin sessions.
3. Keep source-of-truth transitions in FirebaseAccessRepository so audit is transactionally recorded and server rules remain authoritative.
4. Add/adjust ViewModel tests and run app compile plus targeted FirebaseAccessViewModelTest.
5. Validate task and record D1-D7 compliance plus System Decision Impact.

taskChanges.newValue: Implementation complete: FirebaseAccessViewModel now loads a bounded admin queue and exposes guarded approve/reject/revoke transitions with configurable data-group/contractor parameters. FirebaseProjectCatalogScreen renders the queue only when session.isAdmin, hides controls for ordinary users, and routes decisions through FirebaseAccessRepository's transactional audit path. Default approval scope is a valid non-empty data group with ContractorScope.ALL; callers can pass SCOPED contractor selections. Verification: :app:compileDebugKotlin passed; :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests com.mapsupervision.app.auth.FirebaseAccessViewModelTest passed (4 tests, 0 failures); data lifecycle tests remain green. Spec Decision Compliance: D1=pass, D2=pass, D3=pass, D4=pass, D5=pass, D6=pass, D7=pass. System Decision Impact: none — added the approved Android admin presentation without new durable guidance.
